answer: Require each agent identity to lock a small refundable stake and build a verifiable work history before it can trade; new identities start with low trust, and repeated useful work slowly raises a crystal-clear reputation score. A flood of fake identities then faces a gale of costs: each fake must fund its stake and spend time doing real work, while a coordinated summit of honest agents can flag and slash identities that copy or spam, making mass fakery expensive and unprofitable.
